descriptionChirho: The Moabite city of Dibon, mentioned in connection with Israelite settlements and prophetic oracles against Moab. All occurrences refer to the same geographic location regardless of prepositional prefix (from, in, and). Consistent across translations: eng 'Dibon/Divon', spa 'Dibon', hin 'dibon', arb 'dibun', kor 'dibon', swa 'Diboni'.
